---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem in Newton
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

Before filing, search existing issues. For a security vulnerability, follow
[the security policy](https://github.com/Galbaz1/newton/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
instead. Use synthetic data and remove secrets,
customer material and private logs.

### What happened?

Describe the actual behavior and what you expected instead.

### How can we reproduce it?

List the shortest steps, including a synthetic input or fixture when relevant.

### Environment

Give the Newton commit or version, operating system and relevant Python/Node
versions. State whether this was a local or self-hosted installation.

### Checks and evidence

List any focused tests you ran. Add a sanitized error or screenshot if it helps.
